tool.name: AddPrimaryCategoryField
tool.summary: Parse the JSON-encoded categories column of Overture place features and add a primary_category text field containing the primary category value.

usage.bullet_item: The input features must contain a categories field with JSON-encoded category data from Overture Maps.
This tool is intended for use with Overture place features, which are the only type that includes a categories column.

param.name: input_features
param.dialogReference: The feature layer or feature class containing a categories column to parse.
